Think in English; respond in Japanese. Use British English in code: `optimiser`, `serialisation`, `modelling`, `visualisation`. **Do NOT maintain backward compatibility** unless explicitly requested. Follow the user's instructions precisely, and within that scope act autonomously.

Stable: `cargo clippy --workspace --exclude pricer_pricing --exclude pricer_risk -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace --exclude pricer_pricing --exclude pricer_risk`
Nightly: `cargo +nightly test -p pricer_pricing && cargo +nightly test -p pricer_risk`
Full integration: `cargo +nightly test --workspace`

A-I-P-S strict unidirectional: Adapter → Infra → Pricer (L1–L4) → Service; violations fail CI. Dependencies: S→any | P→never S,A | I→never P,S | A→only I,P. No `Box<dyn Trait>`; use enum + `enum_dispatch` for Enzyme static dispatch. Smoothing mandatory: discontinuous ops use `smooth_max` / `smooth_indicator`. Enzyme requires nightly for `pricer_pricing` and `pricer_risk`.

Keep file lean/current: review regularly; **CRITICAL: Keep total under 20-30 lines of instructions**; move detailed docs to `.claude/steering/`; update commands immediately when workflows change; rewrite Architecture section after major changes; delete inferable instructions.
